summary: LEGO City entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Lego City Undercover
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC 2017 rerelease, with Wii U comparison if original hardware context matters

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; Cemu only for Wii U comparison if hardware is unavailable.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC release, or Wii U hardware for original context

primary.why: Lego City Undercover launched as a Wii U game with GamePad features, then received a 2017 multiplatform release with PC capture/settings advantages and local co-op. PC is the cleanest general archive route, while Wii U is the original hardware context.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront/build, graphics settings, controller/co-op state, save/progression state, and whether Wii U GamePad features were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting the launch hardware experience.
secondary.why: The Wii U version is the original design context, even though PC is the stronger capture route.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC / PlayStation 4 / Xbox One / Nintendo Switch
all_releases.fidelity: Modern multiplatform rerelease with PC preferred for capture/settings.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC is the clean capture route, but Wii U is the original GamePad hardware context.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record co-op state and whether the Wii U GamePad route was compared.
